comments.value: I've seen similar symptoms in others.

I had the same condition.
After that day, the line became heavy and I couldn't play properly.
I can play other games normally, but only VRCHAT has a slow line and the voice and avatar are interrupted.
Could it be a problem with the server?

I've already tried the following.
1.VRChat Client Uninstallation
2. Delete the registry
3.Check the line speed 600MBps
4. Reboot the router

Same. I have an issue about connection.
Since 5/26 JST, I got "connection timed out" error when I'm playing with friends sometimes.
And, when many players in same instance, I have seriously desync position problem.

Same problem happening.
It happens obviously when there is many players.
Internet speed:750Mbps, Vrchat Png:130
Tried re-installing Vrchat.
Alternatively, it looks like I'm not doing a good job of controlling the buffer.
As of 9am Tokyo time, my packet loss phenomenon has stopped.

details:
The world takes a very long time to load.
I can't sync my players well.
Periodically, the connection is broken and it returns to the home.
It started on the night of 5/26.
